attchmntText: Oswal Pumps Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Postal Ballot. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
voiceSummary: Oswal Pumps Limited has declared the voting results for the postal ballot notice dated October 12, 2026. The special resolution regarding the approval of variation of the objects or terms of utilization of the initial public offering proceeds and modification of the time limit for the utilization of the initial public offering proceeds has been passed. The scrutinizer, Mr. Amit Kumar Shukla, reported that out of 11,40,04,897 outstanding shares, 8,66,43,406 valid votes were polled. Of these, 8,66,39,508 votes were in favor, representing 99.996 percent, while 3,898 votes were against, representing 0.004 percent. The remote e-voting period ran from October 13, 2026, to November 11, 2026. The resolution is deemed passed as of November 11, 2026. The company has submitted the voting results and the scrutinizer's report to the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on November 13, 2026.

attchmntText: Oswal Pumps Limited has informed the Exchange about Strategy Presentation.
voiceSummary: Oswal Pumps Limited filed a strategy presentation with BSE and NSE on November 13, 2026. The company is a fully integrated provider of solar pumping systems with backward integration into pumps, motors, solar panels, and mounting structures. Orders executed as of October 31, 2026, totaled 66,508 units. The distributor network reached 1,462 as of September 30, 2026. Revenue from turnkey solar pumping systems accounted for 64.4% in H1 FY27. Government entities contributed 65.1% of revenue in H1 FY27. The company operates two manufacturing facilities with ISO certifications. Oswal Solar Energy Private Limited secured an order for grid-connected rooftop solar plants under the PM-Surya Ghar Scheme. The presentation includes forward-looking statements and risk disclosures.

attchmntText: Oswal Pumps Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Oswal Pumps Limited filed an investor presentation for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The company reported revenue from operations of 5,063 million rupees, a 6.9 percent quarter-on-quarter increase. Operating EBITDA was 574 million rupees with an 11.3 percent margin. Profit after tax stood at 396 million rupees. The solar pump order book is at 9,487 pumps. The company is diversifying into rooftop, utility-scale, and commercial and industrial solar segments with a combined order book of 143 megawatts. Oswal Solar Energy Private Limited plans to establish a 1.2 gigawatt TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility. This initiative is subject to shareholder approval. The presentation is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Oswal Pumps Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Total Income stood at INR. 5,118 million in Q2 FY27, up 6.2% QoQ".
voiceSummary: Oswal Pumps Limited reported unaudited financial results for Q2 FY27. Total income was Rs. 5,118 million, up 6.2% quarter-on-quarter. EBITDA stood at Rs. 628 million with a margin of 12.3%. Profit after tax was Rs. 396 million, with a margin of 7.7%. Diluted EPS was Rs. 3.34. The Board took on record these results on 12th November 2026. The company has announced plans to establish a 1.2 GW TOPCon solar cell manufacturing facility at Karnal, Haryana. The total project cost is estimated at Rs. 4,558.5 million. Funding includes Rs. 2,960.0 million through debt. Rs. 1,598.5 million is proposed from unutilized IPO proceeds. This reallocation is subject to shareholders’ approval. The pump order book stands at 9,487 pumps. The combined order book for rooftop, utility-scale, and commercial solar segments is approximately 143 MW.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the Quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Oswal Pumps Limited has submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The report was issued by ICRA Limited, the Monitoring Agency appointed to monitor the utilization of proceeds raised through the Initial Public Offer of Equity Shares. The document is filed pursuant to Regulation 32 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The report is also available on the company website at https://www.oswalpumps.com/. Anish Kumar, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, signed the communication on November 12, 2026.

attchmntText: Oswal Pumps Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Oswal Pumps Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 6,922.64 million. Net profit was 432.37 million. Basic earnings per share were 3.78. Total assets stood at 21,797.62 million. Cash and cash equivalents were 48.64 million. The independent auditor issued a review report stating no material misstatements were found.

attchmntText: Oswal Pumps Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
